name: Engagement and consolidated emails
summary: Features that keep field teams engaged and keep email volume down: capture gamification and leaderboards (PRD-only), and consolidated emails for mobile uploads and design uploads. Email delivery and preferences are NOTIF-FEAT-01.

roles.note: No gamification code exists. Consolidated upload emails go to the uploading user; recipients for design emails are not defined.

actions.action: Earn points and appear on a leaderboard after opting in
View team scores on a dashboard
Receive the consolidated mobile upload email
actions.note: Sent to the user who uploaded

nfr.statement: How soon a consolidated upload email arrives after the last capture in a session finishes uploading.
nfr.open_question: The PRD says one hour or when all uploads finish. Is that a commitment, and what about uploads still running at 6 pm?

requirements.title: Capture gamification with opt-in leaderboards
requirements.statement: Users earn points for capture streaks, coverage and quality, and get immediate feedback when a capture task completes. Team and individual leaderboards show only users who opted in. Managers see team progress and safety scores.
requirements.rationale: PRD-only. No gamification, scoring or leaderboard code was found in the services or web app read.

acceptance_criteria.given: A field user completes a capture successfully
acceptance_criteria.then: They see feedback and the points earned straight away

acceptance_criteria.given: A user who has not opted into leaderboards
acceptance_criteria.then: That user doesn't appear in any ranking

requirements.title: Mobile uploads from one device send one consolidated email
requirements.statement: Today captures uploaded together from one user's device form a group. When every capture in the group has uploaded, the user gets one email. If the group is still incomplete, the service checks again one hour later and at 6 pm in the project's time zone, and emails the pending list.

open_checks: The one-hour and 6 pm checks are in-process timers

acceptance_criteria.given: A user uploads four captures from one phone and all four finish
acceptance_criteria.then: One email lists the project, capture type, capture time, structure and status of all four

acceptance_criteria.given: Two of four uploads are still running at 6 pm project time
acceptance_criteria.then: An email lists the pending uploads

requirements.title: A consolidated upload email is sent only once
requirements.statement: The PRD says completed uploads must not produce duplicate emails. Today the one-hour and 6 pm checks send the email without marking the group as emailed, so the same group can be emailed by both checks and again on completion.

dispute.summary: PRD EC-002 asks for no duplicates, and EC-001 allows several emails for slow uploads. The scheduled checks leave the "email sent" flag unset (the update is commented out). Product to say how many emails one group may produce.

requirements.title: Design upload notifications are consolidated
requirements.statement: Design upload notifications sent within a 30-minute window are combined into one email.
requirements.rationale: PRD-only. The consolidated email found in code is for snapshots, not design uploads.
